candidates.name: Moving Features
verified_facts: The Moving Features standard specifies encoding representations for movement of geographic features.
Its primary use case is information exchange for moving-feature data.
semantic_limits: Movement encoding represents changing feature state and is not static bare-earth parcel elevation evidence.

candidates.name: Open GeoSMS – Core
verified_facts: Open GeoSMS extends SMS encoding and interfaces to communicate location content between location-based service devices or applications.
The standard focuses on interoperable exchange of location content in short messages.
semantic_limits: A location communicated by SMS is not verified survey evidence and cannot establish parcel terrain elevation or vertical uncertainty.
